target_buyer.organization: Ashtabula County Department of Job and Family Services
target_buyer.why_top_candidate: Determines eligibility for food stamps, Medicaid, Ohio Works First, and childcare assistance. Eligibility screening tools would streamline intake and reduce caseworker workload. Serves as primary entry point for public benefits in Ashtabula County.

actual_brand_research.mission: Provide superior service, promote well-being and self-sufficiency, alleviate conditions of poverty, and improve health and safety
actual_brand_research.visual_style: Professional government, social services, community support

brandkit_for_mvp.proposed_tagline: Find Benefits. Get Help. Move Forward.
brandkit_for_mvp.positioning: The eligibility screening platform for Ashtabula County Job & Family Services — simplifying access to SNAP, Medicaid, cash assistance, and childcare benefits.

visual_direction.hero_image_concept: Diverse families accessing services, community support imagery
visual_direction.color_scheme: Professional blue with supportive green accents

implementation_recommendations.brand_alignment: Align with ACJFS mission of promoting well-being and self-sufficiency
key_features_needed: Multi-program eligibility screener (SNAP, Medicaid, WIC, OWF)
Referral links to county JFS portal
